supports.excerpt:
Without the right tools, AI agents are slow, expensive, and unreliable. Our mission is to bring your agent from prototype to production. Here's why AgentOps stands out:

- **Comprehensive Observability**: Track your AI agents' performance, user interactions, and API usage.
- **Real-Time Monitoring**: Get instant insights with session replays, metrics, and live monitoring tools.
- **Cost Control**: Monitor and manage your spend on LLM and API calls.
- **Failure Detection**: Quickly identify and respond to agent failures and multi-agent interaction issues.
- **Tool Usage Statistics**: Understand how your agents utilize external tools with detailed analytics.
- **Session-Wide Metrics**: Gain a holistic view of your agents' sessions with comprehensive statistics.

AgentOps is designed to make agent observability, testing, and monitoring easy.

skill_drafts.name: AI Agent Observability Setup
skill_drafts.description: Configure comprehensive monitoring of AI agent performance, user interactions, and API usage to establish foundational observability infrastructure for tracking agent behavior from prototype to production.
applicable_signals: agent prototype ready for production transition
requirement to track user interactions and API usage
multi-agent system requiring holistic session view
contraindications: agent is already fully instrumented with observability tools
no observability or monitoring requirements exist
observability infrastructure is already active and validated
workflow_steps: Enable comprehensive observability tracking for agent performance, user interactions, and API usage
Configure real-time metrics collection and live monitoring tools
Establish session-wide metrics dashboard with holistic agent statistics
Validate that all monitoring components are active and data is flowing
triggers: deploying a new AI agent system to production
scaling an existing agent system and need visibility into performance
establishing baseline metrics for agent behavior tracking
preparing agent for multi-stage monitoring (cost control, failure detection)
constraints: must establish foundational observability before implementing specialized monitoring (cost control, failure detection)
session replay and metrics collection must be active before downstream monitoring tasks
cautions: observability setup is prerequisite; do not skip to cost control or failure detection without active monitoring dashboard
output_contract: Monitoring dashboard is active and operational with real-time session replays, performance metrics, and API usage statistics visible and accessible for downstream monitoring and optimization tasks.

metadata.prompt: Set up observability infrastructure for your AI agent system. Enable tracking of agent performance metrics, user interactions, and API usage. Verify that session replays, real-time metrics, and live monitoring tools are active and accessible. Ensure the monitoring dashboard displays comprehensive session-wide statistics before proceeding to specialized monitoring tasks like cost control or failure detection.

skill_drafts.name: Agent Cost and Spend Management
skill_drafts.description: Monitor and control spending on LLM and API calls to optimize agent operational costs and prevent budget overruns.
applicable_signals: budget allocation or spending limits defined
multi-agent or high-volume API usage pattern
contraindications: cost is not a constraint or concern
agent is in early prototype phase with no budget limits
no spending thresholds or budget caps defined
workflow_steps: Configure cost tracking for all LLM and API calls
Define budget limits and spending thresholds
Enable real-time spend monitoring and aggregation
Set up alerts for threshold breaches
Generate cost dashboards showing spend per session and per call
triggers: agent scaling to handle increased load
budget constraints or cost control requirements identified
need to track spend per session or per API call
constraints: requires integration with LLM and API call tracking systems
thresholds and budget limits must be configured before monitoring begins
cost data must be collected and aggregated per session and per call
cautions: alerts should trigger before budget is fully exhausted to allow corrective action
cost tracking overhead should not significantly impact agent performance
output_contract: Cost dashboard displaying spend per session, spend per API call, budget utilization percentage, and alerts triggered when spending approaches or exceeds defined thresholds. Actionable insights on which operations or calls are most expensive.

metadata.prompt: Set up cost tracking for your agent's LLM and API calls. Configure spend limits and thresholds. Monitor actual spend against budget in real time. Generate alerts when spending approaches or exceeds defined thresholds. Use cost dashboards to identify expensive operations and optimize call patterns.

skill_drafts.name: Agent Failure Detection and Response
skill_drafts.description: Identify and respond to agent failures and multi-agent interaction issues in real-time to maintain reliability and prevent cascading failures in production environments.
contraindications: agent is in isolated testing phase
system is in development or prototype stage
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Monitor agent execution state and multi-agent interactions', 'condition': 'continuous during active session'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Detect failure signal (task failure, communication error, state anomaly)', 'condition': 'when failure condition is met'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Gather failure context (agent state, recent actions, error logs)', 'condition': 'immediately upon failure detection'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Generate alert with failure details and recommended remediation', 'condition': 'after context gathering'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Log incident with full context for analysis', 'condition': 'concurrent with alert'}
{'step': 6, 'action': 'Notify operator or escalation handler', 'condition': 'based on severity and escalation policy'}
constraints: must operate in real-time or near-real-time
alert must include actionable remediation guidance
incident logging must be complete for audit trail
cautions: avoid alert fatigue from overly sensitive failure thresholds
ensure multi-agent failure detection does not block independent agent recovery
verify remediation steps are safe before auto-execution
output_contract: Alert message containing: failure type, affected agent(s), failure timestamp, relevant execution context, and recommended remediation steps. Incident record created in audit log with full details for post-incident review.

metadata.prompt: Monitor agent execution for failures and multi-agent interaction issues. When a failure is detected, trigger an alert with failure details and recommended remediation steps. Log the incident for post-incident analysis.
